newsitem.title: USA: Goodyear to announce alliance, writeoffs - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Goodyear to announce alliance, writeoffs - WSJ.

text.p: Goodyear Tire & Rubber is expected to announce today a strategic alliance with Sumitomo Rubber Industries, the Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday.
The report, citing people familiar with both companies, said Goodyear and Sumitomo will make tires for one another in Asia and North America under the pact.
Late Tuesday a Sumitomo spokesman told Reuters that the company had agreed to produce Goodyear-brand tires in Japan, but declined further comment.

The report said Goodyear is also expected to disclose more than $200 milion in write-offs taken in the fourth quarter to restructure production plants in Latin America, Europe and North America, but said it was unclear what the impact would be on fourth quarter results.

According to the paper, tires made in the first phase of the Sumitomo alliance would be distributed under existing pacts with an affiliate of Toyota and let Sumitomo's U.S. affiliate, Dunlop Tire, buy tires from Goodyear.
Goodyear could not be reached immediately for comment.
